What Is Khalti Pro?

Khalti Pro is a premium annual subscription designed for KYC-verified Khalti users who want to get more value from their everyday digital transactions.

From mobile top-up cashback and enhanced Daaami Points to free transfers, a complimentary Khalti Digital Card, and exclusive coupons across multiple services, Khalti Pro brings together a range of benefits under one affordable annual membership.

 

Khalti Pro at a Glance

  • Subscription: NPR 365 per year

  • Daily cost: Just Re. 1 per day

  • Validity: 1 year from the date of activation

  • Eligibility: KYC-verified Khalti users

  • Experience: Enhanced UI/UX

  • Benefits: Cashback, rewards, free transfers, digital card, exclusive coupons and offers

 

 

Why Go Pro with Khalti?

Khalti Pro is designed to make your everyday Khalti experience more rewarding. Here are the key benefits you can enjoy as a Pro member.

 

1. Get 2% Cashback on Self-Mobile Top-Up

Regularly recharge your own mobile number through Khalti?

With Khalti Pro, you can enjoy 2% cashback on self-mobile top-ups, helping you save on one of the most common digital transactions.

2. Earn 2X Daaami Points

Your everyday eligible payments can now bring you even more rewards.

Khalti Pro members receive 2X Daaami Points on eligible payments, allowing you to earn more points while using Khalti for your regular transactions.

The more you use Khalti for eligible payments, the more opportunities you have to earn and enjoy the benefits of the Daaami ecosystem.

3. Unlimited Free Khalti-to-Khalti Transfers

Sending money to another Khalti user?

With Khalti Pro, you get unlimited free Khalti-to-Khalti transfers, making it easier to send money to friends and family without worrying about additional transfer charges.

Whether you’re splitting a bill, sending money to family, or settling up with a friend, your transfers become even more convenient.

4. Get 5 Free Bank Transfers Every Month

Need to transfer money from your Khalti Wallet to a bank?

Khalti Pro gives you 5 free bank transfers every month, helping you save more while managing your digital money.

It is another way Khalti Pro makes everyday financial transactions more convenient and cost-effective.

5. Get a Free Khalti Digital Card

Khalti Pro members can also enjoy a free Khalti Digital Card while their Pro membership remains active.

Your Digital Card adds another layer of convenience to your digital payment experience and is available as part of your Pro membership.

6. Unlock Exclusive Coupons and Offers

You can discover offers across categories such as:

  • Movies

These offers are designed to give Pro members additional opportunities to save while using services available through the Khalti ecosystem.

7. Enjoy Additional Pro-Exclusive Discounts

Being a Pro member also means getting access to additional Pro-exclusive discounts and promotional offers.

As new offers and promotions become available, Khalti Pro members can enjoy opportunities designed specifically to add more value to their membership.

How to Get Khalti Pro?

Getting Khalti Pro is simple.

Step 1: Open the Khalti App

Log in to your KYC-verified Khalti account.

Step 2: Find Khalti Pro

Inside Entertainment & Lifestyle section click on Khalti Pro or banner within the Khalti app.

Step 3: Select Khalti Pro

Open the Khalti Pro section and review the available membership benefits.

Step 4: Subscribe

Proceed with the subscription payment of NPR 365 for one year.

Once your subscription is successfully activated, you can start enjoying your Khalti Pro benefits.
